metadata.title: Pop Art Heart and Lips Graphic

retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant pop-art composition featuring a large silver heart overlaid with stylized pink lips and black gestural outlines against a solid cyan field.

recipe.visualDefinition: A flat, high-contrast graphic featuring a central silver heart shape. Overlapping the heart is a pair of pink lips defined by thick, expressive black brushstrokes and a central 'X' mark. The entire composition sits on a bright cyan background with two abstract, eye-like shapes in the upper corners. Text is contained within a black rectangular bar and a smaller line below.
coreVisualRelationships: Pink lips centered over a larger silver heart
Solid cyan background providing high contrast for all elements
Black gestural outlines defining the organic lip shapes
Horizontal black text bar anchoring the lower third of the composition
coreInvariants: The central heart must be a flat silver or light grey tone.
The lips must be rendered in a bright pink with thick, imperfect black outlines.
The background must be a uniform, saturated cyan.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The heart and lips occupy the central 60% of the frame, scaled to dominate the visual field.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black rectangular text bar serves as the primary horizontal anchor in the lower half.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the high-contrast pink lips, move up to the corner abstract shapes, and settle on the black text bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant cyan negative space surrounds the central cluster, creating a clean, modern feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background contrasted with a muted metallic silver and vibrant pink.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights or sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century modern aesthetic of the layout.
Standard neo-grotesque that maintains the required neutrality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid cyan background. In the center, place a large silver heart. Over the heart, draw stylized pink lips with thick, expressive black outlines and a black 'X' in the center. Add two small, abstract grey and pink eye-like shapes in the top corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a horizontal black rectangle in the lower third. Inside the rectangle, center white sans-serif text. Below the rectangle, add a smaller line of black sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid cyan?
Are the lips pink with thick black outlines?
Is the main text white inside a black bar?
Is the heart silver and centered?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or album titles.
Do not replicate the exact brushstroke pattern of the lips.

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the heart and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black 'X' on the lips is clearly visible.
Verify the text is perfectly centered within the black bar.
Check that the cyan is vibrant and not muted.
Confirm the silver heart has a flat, non-gradient appearance.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a solid vibrant background with a central metallic icon, overlaid with a gestural organic shape and anchored by a geometric text block.
